chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Sa'd Abadi narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi from his father from Zur'a from Sama'a ibn Mihran from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad from his father (peace be upon them both). He said:
Any traveler who prays the Friday prayer out of desire for it and love for it, Allah -- Mighty and Majestic is He -- will give him the reward of one hundred Friday prayers of a resident.

key_terms.الْجُمُعَةَ: Jumu'a (Friday prayer): the obligatory congregational prayer on Fridays
key_terms.مُسَافِرٍ: Traveler: one who is traveling and therefore exempt from Friday prayer in jurisprudence

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for a traveler who prays Friday prayer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father (peace be upon them both), reported that any traveler who prays the Friday prayer out of desire and love for it, Allah (Mighty and Majestic) will give him the reward of one hundred Friday prayers of a resident. This hadith encourages travelers to attend the congregational Friday prayer despite their exemption from it, promising extraordinary reward.
